description: Ticket actions the app has, on its own routes. Saving stores the slip only; nothing is placed. save_live: POST tickets/live the app Live slip body (selections at the prices shown); import: POST tickets/import the app import confirmation body; from_link: POST slip/from-link {url}: a DraftKings or FanDuel bet link.

body.description: The app request body for this action, unchanged.

commandKey.description: Writes: one stable key per write, reused on every retry.

statedPrices.description: save_live: the X-BSD-Stated-Prices value the app sends for the prices shown.
